title: Towards Time-Resolved Electron Tomography and 4D-STEM
content: In recent years, ultrafast transmission electron microscopy (UTEM) [1] has developed immeasurably and is now a widespread platform, enabling scientific explorations with nanometer-femtosecond spatiotemporal resolution, through the merger of electron microscopy and ultrafast laser technology. In essence, the UTEM is a pump-probe setup, that uses femtosecond laser pulses as the pump and femtosecond electron pulses as the probe, granting us access to microscopic phenomena at their natural time-scale.
